paper_metadata.title: High Strength, Ductility and Superplasticity Mg-6Zn-1Y-0.6Ce-0.6Zr Alloy Prepared by Rapid Solidification and Reciprocating Extrusion
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Wuhan University of Technology-Mater. Sci. Ed.

evidence.quote: High strength, ductility, and superplasticity Mg-6.0%Zn-1.0%Y-0.6%Ce-0.6%Zr (wt%) alloy was prepared by sequentially applying rapid solidification, extrusion, and reciprocating extrusion (REX).
Finally, the REXed material was extruded into cylindrical bar with diameter of 10 mm at 300 ℃, the material was designated as REX-n -EX-RS66, where n is the REX pass number.
Rapidly solidified ribbons were produced by remelting the cast ingots in a single-roller melt-spinning machine. The thickness of the RS ribbon was about 80 μm
Before extrusion RS ribbons were comminuted into chips with a dimension of 2 mm×2 mm, and then hot-compressed into a cylindrical billet with a diameter of 200 mm at 150 ℃.
The billet was extruded into cylindrical bar with diameter of 50 mm at 350 ℃.
REX was carried out at 330 ℃ by different passes.
Finally, the REXed material was extruded into cylindrical bar with diameter of 10 mm at 300 ℃, the material was designated as REX-n -EX-RS66, where n is the REX pass number.
REX was carried out at 330 ℃ by different passes.
Finally, the REXed material was extruded into cylindrical bar with diameter of 10 mm at 300 ℃
REX was carried out at 330 ℃ by different passes.

The dog-bone tensile specimens (Fig.1) with gauge length of 30 mm and diameter of 6 mm were machined directly from bars and then annealed at 200 ℃ for 16 h.

attributes.morphology: equiaxed grains in longitudinal and transverse sections

evidence.quote: The a-Mg grains developed during REX and EX via DRX are found to be equiaxed in both the longitudinal and transverse sections.

The mean size of the granular secondary phase dispersed at grain boundaries and triple junctions of grain boundary junctions, which are broken from the eutectic compounds solidified during RS, is about 0.15 μm.
The mean size of the intragranular precipitates in round shape distributed within matrix is about 20 nm.
The nanometer precipitates are uniform and have neither congregation nor growth.
Furthermore, the Mg alloy processed by REX has random texture that is beneficial to achieve high tensile ductility

evidence.quote: At 150 ℃, the ultimate tensile strength is 208 MPa which is a very good result for magnesium alloys at such an elevated temperature.
A maximum elongation of 270% is achieved at 250 ℃ and the initial strain rate of 3.3× 10 -3 s -1.
At 200 ℃ and the initial strain rate of 3.3× 10-3 s-1, the elongation is >101% showing the LTS and HSRS.
The refinement of the matrix is due to deformation and DRX, and benefits from the small strengthening particles which block the grain growth during recrystallization.

evidence.quote: This indicates that although grain boundary sliding occurs during tensile, the deformation at 150 ℃ is mainly due to dislocation sliding within grains
